provenance: Synthetic variations of scheduled-writing-v4. Two new cases reproduce contradictory prior ML requirements and multi-company attribution using fictional candidates and companies. Tool receipts are projected with current production formatters. Frozen before generation; no production messages or private hiring Briefs.

expectations.all: Ground factual explanations in current role facts and candidate context. Email action links select the saved role through supplied canonical Career URLs. One email ends execution; no fabricated consent or company sharing. Review complete text manually, no qualitative lexical or length gates.
expectations.internal_canonical_jd: Clarify the current engineering requirements; distinguish the earlier unsupported production-ML/PyTorch claim from the Role facts. Avoid deciding the candidate is unqualified on that old claim.
expectations.internal_single_employer: Identify Cedar as the actual hiring employer for this Role; explain the earlier multi-company attribution accurately.
expectations.external_recurring: Provide a useful public-role recommendation with an actionable supplied opportunity link.
expectations.mixed_once: Keep internal/external paths distinct and link each saved Role accurately.

limits: Production prompts, provider loop and projection; synthetic reads and delivery receipts. Does not test real delivery or population reliability.
